title: heterotheca villosa var. foliosa
intro: Heterotheca villosa var. foliosa, commonly known as hairy false goldeneye, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family, characterized by its hairy stems and leaves. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy. The therapeutic actions of hairy false goldeneye are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, which may also contribute to its potential as an antiseptic agent. The bioactive constituents of Heterotheca villosa var. foliosa include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
